newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAILAND'S WATTACHAK PLC TO CLOSE PAPER.
newsitem.headline: THAILAND'S WATTACHAK PLC TO CLOSE PAPER.

text.p: Thai media company Wattachak Plc will close its English language daily Thailand Times because of financial constraints, a senior executive said on Wednesday.
"We will discontinue Thailand Times, the last publication will be August 15," Wattachak Group Vice-Chairman Praphan Boonyakiet told Reuters on Wednesday.
"Frankly speaking, during this Thai market situation we have to consolidate," he said.
The closure comes as Thailand goes through a severe economic crisis which led to a $16 billion bailout by the International Monetary Fund to help rescue the fractured economy.
The Wattachak Group holds stakes in cable television service Thai Sky Cable TV, the Media Plus radio network, and several other print publications.
Staff at Thailand Times, which was launched in October 1993 and covers local news, will be offered jobs at Thai Sky Cable TV, Praphan said.
Thai Sky Cable TV has been off air since last week due to payment difficulties on satellite space rented from Thai communications group Shinawatra.

Holders of Wattachak's $70 million eurobond have been informed of the latest developments and the firm continues to have the support of its major local backer First Bangkok City Bank Plc, Praphan said.
